department: Department of Materials Science and Metallurgy

deadline.value: Funding deadline December 8, 2026 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact staff in their area, and must name 1-4 potential supervisors in the application.
supervisor.quote: Prospective applicants are encouraged to make contact with academic staff in their area of interest to discuss the research opportunities available before making an application.

funding.value: A limited number of EPSRC studentships, open to UK and international candidates; apply by 8 December 2026 for the best chance.
funding.quote: The department has a limited number of EPSRC studentships and applicants are strongly encouraged to apply by the deadline of 8 December 2026

entry_route.value: Expects a UK four-year master's or a bachelor's plus a relevant one- or two-year master's, or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: Students should have achieved at least a good upper second-class honours degree in a UK four-year master's degree or a UK three-year bachelor's (honours) degree plus a relevant one- or two-year master's degree or equivalent.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
